Codifying Trump Border policies is one of the most important things Congress can pass. 

We can build a wall from Brownsville to San Diego, but if we don’t permanently fix catch-and-release, fix asylum and end the abuse of parole authority we saw under the Biden administration, we’ll face another border crisis in the future.
